key_insight: DiscoPER is an autonomous discovery framework that uses iterative meta-reflection to generate, test, and redirect hypotheses in open-ended scientific exploration.
engineering_relevance: It shows how LLM agents can be combined with code execution, statistical validation, and multimodal tool use to support scalable, data-driven discovery workflows.
method: Dynamically generates and executes code to explore datasets without pre-specified research questions.
Uses second-order meta-reflection to analyze prior discoveries, identify gaps/confounds, and steer search into new regions.
Expands hypothesis search with tool use for extracting information from multimodal sources such as images.
evidence_signal: On iNatDisco, DiscoPER recovered 8 of 9 known patterns with a 72.7% hypothesis support rate, outperforming classical causal discovery and LLM-guided baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on reliable statistical testing and tool pipelines, and open-ended search may still be sensitive to dataset quality or hallucinated hypotheses.
paper_title: Autonomous Scientific Discovery via Iterative Meta-Reflection
